title: 第三章 参加电视目录制3第四章 参加电视目录制4
content_zh:
紫萱已经到了位，不过还没正式开始录制。
她笑着对我说：“待会儿我会很犀利的攻击语气哦，你要有思想准备。”
我看着这张不在摄像机下精致的脸，笑了笑：“知道。
我的心会不会血淋淋啊？”
不知怎么地，我听到攻击这个词，攻击和公鸡这两词在我脑海里似乎两个就是同义词，家里山上两只公鸡总是为了一己私欲攻击得头破血流的。
她这么一说，我就在想，我是哪只公鸡？斗战胜佛还是耷拉的货？
紫萱露出蒙娜丽莎般的谜之微笑：“你觉得呢？”
我说：“我怎么有种引火烧身的感觉？”
紫萱的笑露出八颗牙齿：“俗气一点，引火烧身就当是做个火疗。
高大上一点，引火烧身就当是凤凰涅槃。”
场务跑过来对她说可以开始了。
于是在场的都各就各位。
一切都准备好以后，紫萱在摄像开始后先来了个小总结：“刚才我们和林凡聊的是80后的现实，关于健康、父母和工作。
健康是重要的，父母也是，这两者都稳妥无碍的话，那么工作就是最重要的了，要知道，通过自己的能力创造，才是创造，不是每一个人都会有一个富一代爸爸。
林凡，你在工作上有什么经历让你产生工作就像飞跃悬崖？”
我略一沉思：“如果团队里有能力不及的队友，阳奉阴违得厉害。
这个对团队的团结、事情的进程和市场的占有打击比较大。”
紫萱问：“你说的阳奉阴违，就是有人特意拖后腿的意思？就像姜文电影《让子弹飞》里说的：步子迈得太大，后面那句那个什么？”
她没将后面的说出来，却掩嘴笑了起来。
突然之间，我的直觉让我感觉这是个纯24K的套儿，做不好事情，只能说明自己的能力未及，大忌就是将做不好事情的责任向外推卸。

我现在唯一能找的理由就是对于这种貌似温和的问答中却暗藏了咄咄逼人的台词，我却反应迟缓，因为太过信任对方的善意。
我心里暗自定了定神，还清了清嗓子：“或者是自己的道行不够吧！
工作的内容总是在变化，思想没跟上。”
紫萱紧追不舍：“你说的是工作能力还是工作态度？”
我的眉头皱了起来，嘴也抿了起来，看着她，下半场这些问题是没有了彩排稿的了，难怪个个都说下半场的紫萱有点像下半场的恒大，惹不起。
我在思想该如何回答的时候，她主动来解围了：“这么说吧！
假如你对现在的工作或者工作环境不满意，你是不是会有其他想法，比如说跳槽或者自己创业？”
这是才比较正常的问法啊，不过不出彩，这我知道，太过平庸，对观众没有吸引力。
“这两样我都有想过，在某一段时期有很强烈的想法，很想去试试。”
我老老实实的回答，我相信这种状态是很多人的常规想法，至于是否能勇敢迈出第一步，另当别论。
果然，紫萱追了下来：“但是这两样选项你到现在都没去试过，对吧？”
我觉得似乎手心开始有点湿漉漉，轻轻的握了握，但是没逃过紫萱的眼睛。
content_en:
Zixuan is already in place, but the recording has not officially started yet.
She smiled and said to me: "I will be very aggressive later, so you have to be mentally prepared."
I looked at this delicate face that was not under the camera and smiled: "I know.
Will my heart be bloody? "
Somehow, I heard the word attack. The two words attack and rooster seemed to be synonymous in my mind. The two roosters on the mountain at home always attacked to a bloody head for their own selfish desires.
When she said that, I was thinking, which rooster am I? A victorious Buddha or a droopy commodity?
Zixuan showed a mysterious smile like the Mona Lisa: "What do you think?"
I said, "Why do I feel like I'm on fire?"
Zixuan's smile showed eight teeth: "To be more tacky, setting yourself on fire is like doing fire therapy.
If you are taller, you can be like a phoenix rising from the ashes. "
The steward ran over to her and told her it was time to start.
So everyone present took their places.
After everything was ready, Zixuan gave a brief summary before the filming started: "What we were talking about with Lin Fan just now was about the reality of the post-80s generation, about health, parents and work.
Health is important, and so are parents. If both are in good condition, then work is the most important. You must know that creation through one's own abilities is creation. Not everyone will have a rich father.
Lin Fan, what experiences have you had at work that made you feel like your work was like jumping off a cliff? "
I pondered for a while: "If there are teammates in the team who are not as capable as they are, it will be very serious.
This has a greater impact on the unity of the team, the process of things, and the market share. "
Zixuan asked: "What do you mean when you say that someone is deliberately holding back? It's like what Jiang Wen said in the movie "Let the Bullets Fly": The step is too big, what is that sentence at the end?"
She didn't say the rest, but she covered her mouth and laughed.
Suddenly, my intuition made me feel that this was a pure 24K scheme. Failure to do things well only meant that one was not up to the level of ability. The taboo was to shirk the responsibility for failure to do things to others.
The only reason I can find now is that I was slow to react to the aggressive lines hidden in this seemingly gentle Q&A because I trusted the other party's goodwill too much.
I calmed myself down in my mind and cleared my throat: "Maybe I'm not good enough!
The content of work is always changing, and my thinking has not kept up. "
Zixuan chased after her: "Are you talking about work ability or work attitude?"
I frowned, pursed my lips, and looked at her. There was no rehearsal draft for these questions in the second half. No wonder everyone said that Zixuan in the second half was a bit like Evergrande in the second half and couldn't be offended.
When I was thinking about how to answer, she came to the rescue: "Let's put it this way!
If you are dissatisfied with your current job or working environment, do you have other ideas, such as changing jobs or starting your own business? "
This is a more normal way to ask, but it's not outstanding. I know this. It's too mediocre and unattractive to the audience.
"I have thought about both of these. At a certain period, I had a strong idea and wanted to try it."
I answer honestly, I believe this state is the conventional thinking of many people, and whether they can bravely take the first step is another matter.
Sure enough, Zixuan chased after her: "But you haven't tried these two options until now, right?"
I felt as if my palms were starting to get a little wet, so I squeezed them gently, but it didn't escape Zixuan's eyes.
